notes:
Summary: DeepShadow is a fast-growing developer tools company building an internal code search + code assistant product for enterprise customers. They have ~45M file-level code/context objects and expect ~30M-60M embeddings at peak. Primary asks: low-latency retrieval + cross-encoder reranking, predictable unit cost, and strict SSO/SAML + audit log requirements.

Key quotes from call: "We cannot leak any code outside our VPC — private control plane or on-prem is mandatory for early customers." "Reindexing will be continuous — many small PR-driven updates, need incremental ingest without full rebuilds."

Indexing scale: pilot 5M vectors, production target 30M-60M. Reindex cadence: incremental streaming updates (hours), full re-index weekly for metadata refresh.

Latency & throughput targets: 95th pct retrieval < 120ms, end-to-end retrieval + rerank (default cross-encoder) P95 < 400ms, throughput target during peak CI search bursts ~120 qps.

Cost constraints: target cost-per-query (median) < $0.015 across retrieval + rerank for 60M corpus; willing to trade small latency increase for 2x cost reduction.

Model preferences: prefer open, quantizable cross-encoder for rerank (e.g., distilled bert/roberta variants) and a production ANN first-pass (HNSW or IVF+PQ) for recall. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for quantization profiles + batching.

Security: SSO via SAML with IdP initiated flows, signed metadata, SCIM for provisioning. KMS/HSM integration required for key material. Audit logs retention 1 year (enterprise customers require 2 years in roadmap). Data residency: US only for now.

POC constraints: limited egress during POC, will provide a mirror of repo data in a VPC subnet. Need signed MOU for temporary access and a network allowlist.

Other notes: Legal wants explicit IP clause about model fine-tuning (no fine-tuning w/ customer code). Engineering asked for a smoke test script to validate incremental re-index correctness.
use_case_summary: Primary workload: RAG for code search + internal code assistant. Large embedding corpus (~30M-60M vectors). Frequent small updates (PR-driven) require incremental indexing. Retrieval first-pass via ANN, followed by cross-encoder rerank for precision. Strict SSO/SAML + audit/KMS. Looking for private or on-prem deployment with predictable pricing and fallback routing for burst capacity.
technical_requirements: Incremental / streamable ingest API (no full rebuild every update)
Support for 30M-60M vectors with autoscaling GPU pools
ANN index options (HNSW, IVF+PQ) + persistent storage snapshotting

P99 latency measurement and tracing hooks per-token
KMS/HSM integration and signed audit logs
